[[File:Aud Voss Eriksen (2017-03-11 bilde01).jpg|thumb|Voss Eriksen in 2017]]
'''Aud Voss Eriksen''' (4 May 1937 – 8 November 2024) was a Norwegian politician for the [[Conservative Party (Norway)|Conservative Party]].

==Life and career==
Eriksen was born and grew up in [[Oslo]], but moved to [[Stavanger]] where she finished her secondary education. She studied science at the [[University of Oslo]], and was hired as chief chemist for [[Exxon]] in Bangkok. She lived in Thailand and the United States for twelve years before moving to [[Bærum]].<ref name=backgr>{{cite news|title=Ung profil: Førstedamen|last=Fuglehaug|first=Wenche|date=24 February 1990|work=Aftenposten Aften|page=5|language=Norwegian}}</ref>

She started her political career as leader of the Bærum Conservative Women's Association, and advanced to county leader in Akershus.<ref name=backgr/> She was elected to Bærum [[municipal council (Norway)|municipal council]] in 1983.<ref name=jub>{{cite news|title=Jubilanter|work=Dagsavisen|page=45|language=Norwegian|date=4 May 2012}}</ref> She was elected as a deputy representative to the Parliament of Norway from Akershus for the terms 1981–1985, 1985–1989 and 1989–1993. In total she met during 22 days of parliamentary session.<ref>{{stortingetbio|AUER}}</ref> In 1990 she was selected as chairperson of Bærum Conservative Party.<ref name=backgr/> From 1991 to 1999 she served as deputy mayor of Bærum, before retiring from politics. She also chaired the [[Henie-Onstad Art Centre]] from 1996 to 1999.<ref name=jub/>

Eriksen resided at [[Jar, Norway|Jar]] and later at [[Fossum, Akershus|Fossum]]. She was married and had three children.<ref>{{cite news|title=Fortsatt et sterkt engasjement|work=Budstikka|pages=42–43|author=Halvorsen, Stein|language=Norwegian|date=4 May 2012}}</ref> Eriksen died on 8 November 2024, at the age of 87.<ref>{{cite news |title=Tidligere varaordfører Aud Voss Eriksen er død |url=https://www.budstikka.no/tidligere-varaordforer-aud-voss-eriksen-er-dod/s/5-55-1841219 |access-date=11 November 2024 |publisher=Budstikka |date=11 November 2024}}</ref>
